scenes.title: The Multinational Corporate Currency Dilemma
scenes.purpose: Cross-Border FX Mismatches: Global corporations like Airbus manufacture in EUR but sell in USD, facing existential currency risk.
takeaways: Cross-Border FX Mismatches: Global corporations like Airbus manufacture in EUR but sell in USD, facing existential currency risk.
Limits of Linear Forwards: Forward contracts eliminate exchange rate risk but surrender 100% of favorable currency appreciation.
Currency Options Solution: Provides asymmetric downside crash insurance while preserving multi-million dollar upside.

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Consider multinational aircraft manufacturer Airbus: manufacturing costs are in Euros, but global aircraft sales are in US Dollars.

hi.display: Maan lijiye ek international aircraft manufacturer Airbus, jiske manufacturing expenses Europe mein Euro mein hote hain, lekin aircrafts ki sales US Dollar mein hoti hai.

hi.display: Yadi agle 6 months mein Dollar Euro ke mukable 20 percent toot jata hai, toh company ke multi-billion dollar profits palak jhapakte hi losses mein badal sakte hain.

beats.onScreenIntent: The Multinational Corporate Currency Dilemma

en.display: To insulate international balance sheets from FX volatility, global corporations rely on Currency Options.

hi.display: International trade mein currency ke is severe volatility ko hedge karne ke liye world ke sabse bade corporations Currency Options ka upayog karte hain.

hi.display: John Hull ke 17vein adhyay ke is doosre bhag mein, hum seekhenge ki do deshon ki alag-alag interest rates ke beech currency options ka pricing kaise kiya jata hai.

scenes.purpose: Yield Equivalence Principle: Holding foreign cash deposits earns foreign risk-free interest rate r_f continuously.
takeaways: Yield Equivalence Principle: Holding foreign cash deposits earns foreign risk-free interest rate r_f continuously.
Merton Substitution (q = r_f): Replacing continuous dividend yield q with foreign interest rate r_f adapts stock option formulas to FX.
Forward Exchange Rate Parity: The forward rate F_0 = S_0 * e^((r - r_f)*T) embodies covered interest rate parity.

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: To price currency options, John Hull introduces a profound and elegant economic insight.

hi.display: Forex derivatives ki pricing ko samajhne ke liye John Hull ek behad khoobsurat insight dete hain.

beats.onScreenIntent: Foreign Currency as an Asset Providing a Continuous Yield

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Holding foreign currency allows depositing it in a foreign bank to earn the foreign risk-free rate r_f.

hi.display: Jab aap kisi foreign currency jaise Euro ko apne paas rakhte hain, toh use foreign bank mein deposit karke foreign interest rate r f kamaya ja sakta hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: Foreign Currency as an Asset Providing a Continuous Yield

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: This means the foreign interest rate r_f acts exactly as a continuous dividend yield q: simply substitute q = r_f!

hi.display: Iska matlab yeh hua ki foreign interest rate r f theek stock index ke continuous dividend yield q ki tarah kaam karti hai! Bas q ko r f se replace kar dijiye.

scenes.title: The Garman–Kohlhagen Pricing Model
scenes.purpose: Analytical FX Call: c = S_0 * e^(-r_f * T) * N(d1) - K * e^(-r * T) * N(d2).
takeaways: Analytical FX Call: c = S_0 * e^(-r_f * T) * N(d1) - K * e^(-r * T) * N(d2).
Analytical FX Put: p = K * e^(-r * T) * N(-d2) - S_0 * e^(-r_f * T) * N(-d1).
Modified Drift in d1: d1 = [ ln(S_0 / K) + (r - r_f + 0.5*sigma^2)*T ] / [ sigma * sqrt(T) ].

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Examine the most famous currency option formula in global finance: The Garman-Kohlhagen Model.

hi.display: Screen par dekhiye finance ki duniya ka sabse mashhoor currency formula: The Garman-Kohlhagen Model.

beats.onScreenIntent: The Garman–Kohlhagen Pricing Model

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: In this formula, spot FX rate S_0 discounts at foreign rate r_f, while strike K discounts at domestic rate r.

hi.display: Is formula mein spot exchange rate S zero ko foreign interest rate r f se discount kiya jata hai, jabki strike K ko domestic interest rate r se discount kiya jata hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: The Garman–Kohlhagen Pricing Model

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Inside d1, the drift term becomes (r - r_f), capturing the sovereign interest rate spread.

hi.display: Parameter d 1 ke andar drift term r minus r f ban jati hai, jo do deshon ke interest rate differential ko perfectly capture karti hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: The Garman–Kohlhagen Pricing Model

scenes.title: Dual Currency Inversion Symmetry: Calls vs Puts
scenes.purpose: Currency Pair Duality: Every foreign exchange transaction simultaneously involves two currencies.
takeaways: Currency Pair Duality: Every foreign exchange transaction simultaneously involves two currencies.
Mathematical Identity: Call to buy GBP with USD at K is mathematically identical to Put to sell USD for GBP at 1/K.
Symmetry Formula: c(S_0, K, r, r_f, T) = S_0 * K * p*(1/S_0, 1/K, r_f, r, T).

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: The most unique mathematical feature of FX derivatives is Dual Currency Inversion Symmetry.

hi.display: Currency options ki sabse anokhi visheshata hoti hai Dual Currency Inversion Symmetry.

beats.onScreenIntent: Dual Currency Inversion Symmetry: Calls vs Puts

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: A NY call to buy GBP at $1.60 is economically identical to a London put to sell USD at £0.625!

hi.display: Jab New York ka ek trader 1.60 dollar ki strike par Pound buy karne ka Call option khareedta hai, toh theek wahi transaction London ke trader ke liye Dollars sell karne ka Put option ban jata hai jiski strike 0.625 pound hoti hai!

beats.onScreenIntent: Dual Currency Inversion Symmetry: Calls vs Puts

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Both cash flows are identical, allowing global desks to seamlessly hedge cross-currency books.

hi.display: Dono transactions ki cash flows theek barabar hoti hain. John Hull samjhate hain ki yeh symmetry global banks ko dono sides se currency risks seamlessly offset karne ki suvidha deti hai.

scenes.title: Corporate Hedging with Zero-Cost Range-Forward Collars
scenes.purpose: Corporate Dilemma: Outright puts are expensive; forward contracts eliminate all upside participation.
takeaways: Corporate Dilemma: Outright puts are expensive; forward contracts eliminate all upside participation.
Range-Forward Structure: Buy protective put at K1 (floor) and simultaneously sell call at K2 (ceiling).
Zero-Cost Equilibrium: Strikes K1 and K2 are selected such that p(K1) = c(K2), eliminating cash premium outlay.

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Examine how global multinationals execute Zero-Cost Range-Forward Collars without paying cash premiums.

hi.display: Aaiye ab dekhein ki real corporate world mein multinational companies jaise Airbus ya Apple currency options ka upayog bina koi cash premium diye kaise karti hain.

beats.onScreenIntent: Corporate Hedging with Zero-Cost Range-Forward Collars

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Known as a Zero-Cost Range-Forward: The treasurer buys a protective put at floor strike K1.

hi.display: Ise Zero-Cost Range-Forward ya Cylinder kaha jata hai. Corporate treasurer downside risk ko rokne ke liye ek Put option buy karta hai strike K 1 par.

beats.onScreenIntent: Corporate Hedging with Zero-Cost Range-Forward Collars

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: To finance the put, the company sells an out-of-the-money call at ceiling strike K2, achieving a net zero premium outlay!

hi.display: Is put ki cost ko balance karne ke liye, company simultaneously strike K 2 par ek Call option sell kar deti hai, jisse received premium se put ka kharcha theek zero ho jata hai!

beats.onScreenIntent: Corporate Hedging with Zero-Cost Range-Forward Collars

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: The company secures an ironclad floor while retaining participation across a defined exchange rate corridor.

hi.display: Company ko ek guaranteed floor mil jata hai, jabki ek safe corridor mein currency appreciation ka benefit bhi milta hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: Corporate Hedging with Zero-Cost Range-Forward Collars

scenes.title: American Currency Options & Early Exercise Boundary
scenes.purpose: Carrying Yield Arbitrage: Because foreign currency earns continuous rate r_f, deep in-the-money American options may be exercised early.
takeaways: Carrying Yield Arbitrage: Because foreign currency earns continuous rate r_f, deep in-the-money American options may be exercised early.
Call Early Exercise Condition: Optimal to exercise American call early if foreign rate r_f significantly exceeds domestic rate r.
Put Early Exercise Condition: Optimal to exercise American put early if domestic rate r significantly exceeds foreign rate r_f.

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Let us examine the early exercise mechanics of American Currency Options.

hi.display: Ab aaiye American Currency Options ke early exercise mechanics ko samjhein.

beats.onScreenIntent: American Currency Options & Early Exercise Boundary

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Unlike stock calls which exercise only before dividends, foreign currencies accrue interest r_f every day.

hi.display: Stock options mein American call ko keval dividend se pehle exercise karna optimal hota hai. Lekin currency mein foreign interest rate r f har roz milta hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: American Currency Options & Early Exercise Boundary

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: If foreign interest rate r_f significantly exceeds domestic rate r, early call exercise is mathematically optimal.

hi.display: Yadi foreign interest rate domestic rate se kaafi zyada ho, toh American call ko early exercise karke foreign currency apne account mein lena profitable ho jata hai.

scenes.title: The Volatility Smile in Foreign Exchange Markets
scenes.purpose: Failure of Lognormal Flat Vol: Market implied volatilities are not constant; deep OTM calls and puts trade at high implied vol.
takeaways: Failure of Lognormal Flat Vol: Market implied volatilities are not constant; deep OTM calls and puts trade at high implied vol.
Prominent U-Shaped Smile: FX options exhibit a distinct symmetric U-shaped volatility smile reflecting jump risk and fat tails.
Risk Reversals & Skew: Skew between OTM calls and puts measures the directional bias and central bank intervention likelihood.

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: In real financial markets, an essential empirical concept is the Volatility Smile.

hi.display: Real financial markets mein ek aur critical concept hai jise Volatility Smile kaha jata hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: The Volatility Smile in Foreign Exchange Markets

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: While Black-Scholes assumes a flat constant volatility, deep OTM currency options trade at elevated implied volatilities.

hi.display: Black-Scholes model yeh assume karta hai ki volatility har strike par flat hoti hai. Lekin reality mein, deep out-of-the-money currency calls aur puts bahut higher implied volatility par trade karte hain.

beats.onScreenIntent: The Volatility Smile in Foreign Exchange Markets

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: This creates a characteristic U-shaped smile, reflecting that real FX markets experience jumps far more frequently than Gaussian models predict.

hi.display: Isse graph par ek smile jaisa shape banta hai, jo yeh darshata hai ki real foreign exchange markets mein extreme crashes aur jumps Gaussian model se kahin zyada frequently aate hain.

beats.onScreenIntent: The Volatility Smile in Foreign Exchange Markets

scenes.title: Interactive Technical Quiz: Impact of Foreign Interest Rate Shifts
scenes.purpose: Question Focus: Evaluate the effect of an increase in foreign risk-free rate r_f on European currency call and put prices.
takeaways: Question Focus: Evaluate the effect of an increase in foreign risk-free rate r_f on European currency call and put prices.
Yield Analogy: Foreign rate r_f is the continuous dividend yield q of the foreign currency.
Pricing Result: Higher foreign interest rate lowers European call prices and raises European put prices.

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Let us test your understanding: If foreign interest rate r_f increases, what happens to European currency calls and puts? Consider the options on screen.

hi.display: Aaiye Garman-Kohlhagen model ki understanding ko test karte hain. Yadi sabhi factors constant rahein aur foreign interest rate r f badh jaye, toh European currency call aur put options ki prices par kya impact padega? Screen par diye gaye options par dhyan se vichar kijiye.

beats.onScreenIntent: Interactive Technical Quiz: Impact of Foreign Interest Rate Shifts

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Pause and calculate: Analyze the foreign risk-free rate r_f as continuous dividend yield q in forward parity.

hi.display: Is mathematical concept aur financial derivation ko dhyan se samajhiye.

beats.onScreenIntent: Interactive Technical Quiz: Impact of Foreign Interest Rate Shifts

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Option B is correct: Call values decrease and put values increase! Higher foreign yield lowers the forward exchange rate.

hi.display: Sahi uttar hai Option B! Chunki foreign interest rate r f continuous dividend yield ki tarah kaam karti hai, isliye r f badhne se foreign currency ka forward price gir jata hai, jisse call decrease hoti hai aur put increase ho jati hai.

takeaways: Macroeconomic Arena: Foreign exchange derivatives reflect the monetary policies of global central banks (Fed, ECB, BoJ, BoE).
Interest Rate Differentials: Divergence in rate hike cycles drives multi-billion dollar carry trades and volatility skew shifts.
Gateway to Chapter 18: Futures options and Black's 1976 model provide the ultimate framework for pricing commodity and index derivatives.

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: The currency options market is not merely corporate hedging; it is the world's premier macroeconomic battleground.

hi.display: Currency options ka market keval corporate hedging tak seemit nahi hai, yeh world ka sabse bada macroeconomic arena hai.

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: When the Fed or ECB adjust rates, shifting interest spreads trigger multi-billion dollar volatility flows across FX desks.

hi.display: Jab US Federal Reserve ya European Central Bank interest rates change karte hain, toh interest spread r minus r f shift hota hai, jisse global forex options mein heavy volatility create hoti hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: Macro Reflection: Central Bank Rates & Currency Volatility

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: In Chapter 18, we will explore how John Hull analyzes options written on futures contracts using Black's 1976 model.

hi.display: Agle adhyay mein, hum dekhenge ki John Hull kis prakar Futures contracts par likhe gaye options aur Black ke 1976 model ka analysis karte hain.

scenes.title: Summary: 8 Institutional Rules of Currency Derivatives
scenes.purpose: Foreign Rate Yield: Holding foreign cash yields continuous rate r_f, substituting continuous dividend yield q in BSM.
takeaways: Foreign Rate Yield: Holding foreign cash yields continuous rate r_f, substituting continuous dividend yield q in BSM.
Garman-Kohlhagen Pricing: Discounting S_0 by e^(-r_f*T) and K by e^(-r*T) prices European currency options analytically.
Zero-Cost Hedging: Collars buying puts at K1 and selling calls at K2 create full insurance corridors at zero premium.

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Rule 1: Foreign interest rate r_f functions as continuous dividend yield q, adjusting spot FX to S_0*e^(-r_f*T).

hi.display: Aaiye Currency Options aur Garman-Kohlhagen model ke 8 sansthagat niyam codified karte hain. Niyam ek: Foreign currency par milne wali interest rate r f ek continuous dividend yield ki tarah kaam karti hai, jisse spot exchange rate S zero into e ki power minus r f into T ho jata hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: Summary: 8 Institutional Rules of Currency Derivatives

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Rule 2: Garman-Kohlhagen applies dual discounting; Rule 3: Forward rate F_0 locks options to interest parity.

hi.display: Niyam do: Garman-Kohlhagen model dual discount factors use karta hai, jahan domestic rate r strike ko discount karti hai aur foreign rate r f spot ko discount karti hai. Niyam teen: Covered Interest Parity ke tahat forward exchange rate F zero European FX options ka core anchor hota hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: Summary: 8 Institutional Rules of Currency Derivatives

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Rule 4: Dual currency inversion equates calls to puts; Rule 5: Zero-cost collars self-finance downside floors.

hi.display: Niyam char: Dual currency symmetry ke mutabiq, foreign currency buy karne ka call option strike K par, domestic currency sell karne ke put option strike 1 by K ke theek barabar hota hai. Niyam paanch: Multinational corporations zero-cost range-forward collars use karti hain, jahan put premium call sale se fully finance ho jata hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: Summary: 8 Institutional Rules of Currency Derivatives

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Rule 6: FX volatility smile reflects fat-tail jump risk; Rule 7: Monetary policy divergence drives carry-trade unwinds.

hi.display: Niyam cheh: Currency options market mein volatility smile aur skew central bank interventions aur extreme tail risk ko price karte hain. Niyam saat: Global central banks ke rate cycle divergence se interest spread r minus r f change hota hai, jo major FX carry-trade unwinds ko trigger karta hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: Summary: 8 Institutional Rules of Currency Derivatives

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: Rule 8: Garman-Kohlhagen bridges directly into Fischer Black's 1976 futures options framework for Chapter 18.

hi.display: Niyam aath: Garman-Kohlhagen framework seedhe Fischer Black ke 1976 futures model ki neev rakhta hai, jahan continuous yield futures price forward dynamics mein convert ho jata hai.

beats.onScreenIntent: Summary: 8 Institutional Rules of Currency Derivatives

beats.speaker: mentor

en.display: These eight principles conclude our master study of currency options, leading directly into Futures Options in Chapter 18.

hi.display: Ye aath niyam international financial engineering aur currency risk management ko master karne ke liye anivarya hain, jo agle chapter mein Futures Options ko samajhne ka seedha pathway bante hain.
